window.runDeadCodeDetection = async function() {
    if (!currentRepoUrl) {
        alert('No repo loaded. Dead code detection requires a loaded repository.');
        return;
    }

    const resultsDiv = document.getElementById('analyticsResults');
    resultsDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#ff0; font-size:11px;">Running dead code detection (knip + depcheck)... this may take up to 2 minutes.</div>';

    try {
        const response = await fetch('/api/deadcode', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ url: currentRepoUrl }),
        });

        if (!response.ok) {
            const error = await response.json();
            throw new Error(error.error || 'Dead code detection failed');
        }

        const results = await response.json();

        let html = '<div style="color:#0f8; font-size:11px; margin-bottom:8px;">Dead code detection complete</div>';

        if (results.knip) {
            html += '<div style="color:#8f8; font-size:10px; margin-bottom:6px;"><strong>knip:</strong></div>';
            html += `<pre style="color:#aaa; font-size:9px; white-space:pre-wrap; margin-bottom:8px;">${escapeHtml(results.knip)}</pre>`;
        }

        if (results.depcheck) {
            html += '<div style="color:#8f8; font-size:10px; margin-bottom:6px;"><strong>depcheck:</strong></div>';
            html += `<pre style="color:#aaa; font-size:9px; white-space:pre-wrap; margin-bottom:8px;">${escapeHtml(results.depcheck)}</pre>`;
        }

        if (results.errors && results.errors.length > 0) {
            html += '<div style="color:#f44; font-size:10px; margin-bottom:6px;"><strong>Errors:</strong></div>';
            html += `<div style="color:#f88; font-size:9px;">${results.errors.map(e => escapeHtml(e)).join('<br>')}</div>`;
        }

        resultsDiv.innerHTML = html;
    } catch (err) {
        resultsDiv.innerHTML = `<div style="color:#f44; font-size:11px;">Error: ${escapeHtml(err.message)}</div>`;
    }
};

function computeCommitAgeDays(dateStr) {
    const parsed = Date.parse(dateStr);
    if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) {
        throw new Error('Invalid commit date received for churn heatmap');
    }
    const now = Date.now();
    const diffMs = now - parsed;
    return diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
}

function applyChurnHeatmap() {
    const ages = [];
    for (const node of graphData.nodes) {
        const dateStr = churnByNodeId[node.id];
        if (!dateStr) continue;
        ages.push(computeCommitAgeDays(dateStr));
    }
    if (ages.length === 0) {
        throw new Error('Churn heatmap unavailable — no commit dates fetched');
    }
    const minAge = Math.min(...ages);
    const maxAge = Math.max(...ages);
    for (const node of graphData.nodes) {
        const mesh = nodeMeshes.get(node.id);
        if (!mesh) continue;
        const dateStr = churnByNodeId[node.id];
        if (!dateStr) {
            mesh.material.color.setHex(0x555555);
            mesh.material.emissiveIntensity = 0.1;
            mesh.scale.setScalar(0.9);
            continue;
        }
        const age = computeCommitAgeDays(dateStr);
        const t = maxAge === minAge ? 0 : (age - minAge) / (maxAge - minAge);
        _tmpColor.setHSL(0.02 + 0.55 * t, 1, 0.55);
        mesh.material.color.copy(_tmpColor);
        mesh.material.emissive.copy(_tmpColor);
        mesh.material.emissiveIntensity = 0.65;
        mesh.scale.setScalar(1.15);
    }
}

        applyChurnHeatmap();

};

function applyBlameOverlay() {
    const authorColors = {};
    const palette = [0x00ff88, 0xff6b6b, 0x5cc8ff, 0xffd700, 0xff8800, 0xcc88ff, 0x88ffcc];
    let colorIdx = 0;
    for (const node of graphData.nodes) {
        const mesh = nodeMeshes.get(node.id);
        if (!mesh) continue;
        const blame = blameByNodeId[node.fullPath];
        if (!blame) {
            mesh.material.color.setHex(0x333333);
            mesh.material.emissiveIntensity = 0.1;
            continue;
        }
        if (!authorColors[blame.author]) {
            authorColors[blame.author] = palette[colorIdx % palette.length];
            colorIdx++;
        }
        mesh.material.color.setHex(authorColors[blame.author]);
        mesh.material.emissiveIntensity = 0.5;
    }
    const container = document.getElementById('analyticsResults');
    container.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#ff0;margin-bottom:6px;">Last author per file:</div>';
    for (const [author, color] of Object.entries(authorColors)) {
        const hex = '#' + color.toString(16).padStart(6, '0');
        const div = document.createElement('div');
        div.className = 'ap-result';
        div.innerHTML = `<span style="color:${hex};">■</span> ${escapeHtml(author)}`;
        container.appendChild(div);
    }
}

function addLandmark(node) {
    if (!node || !node.id) {
        throw new Error('Cannot add landmark without node');
    }
    if (landmarks.some((lm) => lm.id === node.id)) {
        return;
    }
    landmarks.push({ id: node.id, label: node.label, path: node.fullPath });
    persistLandmarks();
    renderLandmarks();
}

function persistLandmarks() {
    localStorage.setItem('codechat_landmarks', JSON.stringify(landmarks));
}

function hydrateLandmarks() {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('codechat_landmarks');
    if (!saved) {
        return;
    }
    const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
    if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        throw new Error('Invalid landmarks data');
    }
    landmarks.length = 0;
    for (const lm of parsed) {
        if (lm && lm.id && lm.label) {
            landmarks.push(lm);
        }
    }
}

function renderLandmarks() {
    const container = document.getElementById('landmarkList');
    if (!container) {
        return;
    }
    container.innerHTML = '';
    for (const lm of landmarks) {
        const div = document.createElement('div');
        div.className = 'ap-result';
        div.textContent = lm.label;
        div.onclick = () => flyToNode(lm.id);
        container.appendChild(div);
    }
}

window.playLandmarkTour = function() {
    if (landmarks.length === 0) {
        throw new Error('No landmarks saved for tour');
    }
    if (landmarkTourTimer) {
        clearInterval(landmarkTourTimer);
        landmarkTourTimer = null;
        return;
    }
    let idx = 0;
    flyToNode(landmarks[idx].id);
    landmarkTourTimer = setInterval(() => {
        idx = (idx + 1) % landmarks.length;
        flyToNode(landmarks[idx].id);
    }, 2400);
};

function buildTourLink() {
    if (landmarks.length === 0) {
        throw new Error('No landmarks to export as tour link');
    }
    const ids = landmarks.map((lm) => lm.id).join(',');
    const url = new URL(window.location.href);
    url.searchParams.set('tour', ids);
    return url.toString();
}

window.exportTourLink = function() {
    const link = buildTourLink();
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(link).then(() => {
        const btn = document.querySelector('[onclick="exportTourLink()"]');
        if (!btn) {
            throw new Error('Tour export button missing');
        }
        const originalText = btn.textContent;
        btn.textContent = 'Copied!';
        setTimeout(() => {
            btn.textContent = originalText;
        }, 1800);
    });
};

window.showTourQr = function() {
    const link = buildTourLink();
    const modal = document.getElementById('tourQrModal');
    const img = document.getElementById('tourQrImg');
    const anchor = document.getElementById('tourQrLink');
    if (!modal || !img || !anchor) {
        throw new Error('Tour QR modal elements missing');

window.closeTourQr = function() {

function importTourFromUrl() {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const tour = params.get('tour');
    if (!tour) {
        return;
    }
    const ids = tour.split(',').filter(Boolean);
    for (const id of ids) {
        const node = graphData.nodes.find((n) => n.id === id);
        if (node) {

function applyFolderCollapse() {
    for (const node of graphData.nodes) {
        const mesh = nodeMeshes.get(node.id);
        if (!mesh) continue;
        const isCollapsed = collapsedFolders.has(node.folder);
        mesh.visible = !isCollapsed;
    }
    for (const line of edgeLines) {
        const fromMesh = nodeMeshes.get(line.userData.from);
        const toMesh = nodeMeshes.get(line.userData.to);
        line.visible = !!(fromMesh && toMesh && fromMesh.visible && toMesh.visible);
    }
}

function buildAnalyticsFilters() {
    const langContainer = document.getElementById('langFilters');
    const folderContainer = document.getElementById('folderFilters');
    if (langContainer.children.length > 0) return;

    const langs = {};
    const folders = {};
    for (const n of graphData.nodes) {
        langs[n.lang] = (langs[n.lang] || 0) + 1;
        folders[n.folder] = (folders[n.folder] || 0) + 1;
    }

    for (const [lang, count] of Object.entries(langs).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])) {
        const btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.className = 'ap-btn';
        btn.textContent = `${lang} (${count})`;
        btn.onclick = () => filterByLang(lang);
        langContainer.appendChild(btn);
    }

    for (const [folder, count] of Object.entries(folders).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])) {
        const btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.className = 'ap-btn';
        btn.textContent = `${folder}/ (${count})`;
        btn.onclick = () => {
            if (collapsedFolders.has(folder)) {
                collapsedFolders.delete(folder);
                btn.style.textDecoration = '';
                btn.style.color = '';
            } else {
                collapsedFolders.add(folder);
                btn.style.textDecoration = 'line-through';
                btn.style.color = '#555';
            }
            applyFolderCollapse();
        };
        folderContainer.appendChild(btn);
    }
}

// ANIMATE (fixed node bobbing - no drift)
// ============================================================
let frameCount = 0;

function animate() {
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    frameCount++;

    if (gameStarted && pageVisible) {
        updateMovement();
        updateFlyTarget();
        updateHover();
        if (frameCount % 2 === 0) updateMinimap();
        updateFunctionOrbits();

        // Node bobbing using baseY (no drift)
        const time = Date.now() * 0.001;
        let hasLayoutTransition = false;
        for (const [id, mesh] of nodeMeshes) {
            if (mesh.userData.targetPos) {
                hasLayoutTransition = true;
                mesh.position.lerp(mesh.userData.targetPos, 0.08);
                if (mesh.position.distanceTo(mesh.userData.targetPos) < 0.05) {
                    mesh.position.copy(mesh.userData.targetPos);
                    delete mesh.userData.targetPos;
                }
            } else {
                mesh.position.y = mesh.userData.baseY + Math.sin(time + mesh.position.x * 0.1) * 0.3;
            }
        }
        if (hasLayoutTransition) {
            rebuildEdges();
        }

        // Send position every 3 frames
        if (frameCount % 3 === 0) {
            sendPositionUpdate();
        }

        // Animate agents
        const agentTime = Date.now() * 0.002;
        for (const [id, agentMesh] of agentMeshes) {
            agentMesh.ring.rotation.z = agentTime;
            agentMesh.core.rotation.y = agentTime * 0.5;
            agentMesh.core.rotation.x = agentTime * 0.3;
        }
    }

    renderer.render(scene, camera);
}

function updateFlyTarget() {
    if (!flyTarget.active) {
        return;
    }
    flyTarget.progress += 1;
    const t = flyTarget.progress / flyTarget.durationFrames;
    const eased = t < 0.5 ? 2 * t * t : -1 + (4 - 2 * t) * t;
    playerGroup.position.lerpVectors(flyTarget.from, flyTarget.to, Math.min(eased, 1));
    if (flyTarget.progress >= flyTarget.durationFrames) {
        flyTarget.active = false;
    }
}

window.showBlastRadius = function() {
    if (!selectedNodeId) {
        throw new Error('Select a node first (click it) to see blast radius');
    }
    const transitiveImpact = new Set();
    const queue = [selectedNodeId];
    const visited = new Set([selectedNodeId]);
    let depth = 0;
    while (queue.length > 0 && depth < 3) {
        const next = [];
        for (const id of queue) {
            for (const dep of (adjacencyInList[id] || [])) {
                if (!visited.has(dep)) {
                    visited.add(dep);
                    transitiveImpact.add(dep);
                    next.push(dep);
                }
            }
        }
        queue.length = 0;
        queue.push(...next);
        depth++;
    }
    const impacted = Array.from(transitiveImpact);
    highlightNodes(impacted, `Blast radius of ${selectedNodeId}`);
    setActiveFilterButton('Blast radius (selected node)');
    const container = document.getElementById('analyticsResults');
    const header = document.createElement('div');
    header.style.cssText = 'color:#ff0;margin-bottom:4px;';
    header.textContent = `If you change this file, ${impacted.length} files are impacted:`;
    container.insertBefore(header, container.firstChild);
};

function performSearch(query) {
    const results = document.getElementById('searchResults');
    results.innerHTML = '';
    if (!query || query.length < 2) return;

    if (query.trim().startsWith('?')) {
        const intentQuery = query.trim().slice(1).trim();
        if (intentQuery.length < 2) return;
        const target = resolveIntentTarget(intentQuery);
        if (!target) {
            results.innerHTML = '<div class="search-result" style="color:#666;">No intent match. Try auth, payments, onboarding, notifications, api, data.</div>';
            return;
        }
        const div = document.createElement('div');
        div.className = 'search-result';
        div.textContent = `Jump to: ${target.label}`;
        div.onclick = () => {
            flyToNode(target.id);
            closeSearch();
        };
        results.appendChild(div);
        return;
    }

    const q = query.toLowerCase();
    const source = searchIndex.concat(pathSearchIndex);
    const matches = source
        .filter(item => item.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || item.path.toLowerCase().includes(q))
        .slice(0, 30);

    for (const match of matches) {
        const div = document.createElement('div');
        div.className = 'search-result';
        const kindLabel = match.type === 'file' ? 'FILE' : match.type === 'function' ? 'FN' : match.type === 'class' ? 'CLS' : match.type === 'path' ? 'PATH' : 'VAR';
        const lineInfo = match.line ? `:${match.line}` : '';
        div.innerHTML = `<span class="sr-kind">[${kindLabel}]</span> ${escapeHtml(match.name)} <span class="sr-file">${escapeHtml(match.path)}${lineInfo}</span>`;
        div.onclick = () => {
            if (match.type === 'path' && match.symbolEdge) {
                selectExecutionSymbolPath(match.symbolEdge, match.toId, match.fromId);
            } else if (match.type === 'path') {
                selectExecutionPathNode(match.fromId, true);
            } else {
                flyToNode(match.nodeId);
                selectExecutionPathNode(match.nodeId, false);
            }
            closeSearch();
        };
        results.appendChild(div);
    }
}

function resolveIntentTarget(intentQuery) {
    const tokens = intentQuery.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    const expandedTokens = new Set(tokens);
    for (const t of tokens) {
        if (intentLexicon[t]) {
            intentLexicon[t].forEach((alt) => expandedTokens.add(alt));
        }
    }
    let best = null;
    let bestScore = 0;
    for (const node of graphData.nodes) {
        let score = 0;
        const haystack = `${node.label} ${node.fullPath}`.toLowerCase();
        for (const token of expandedTokens) {
            if (haystack.includes(token)) {
                score += 2;
            }
        }
        if (node.definitions) {
            for (const def of node.definitions) {
                const name = def.name.toLowerCase();
                for (const token of expandedTokens) {
                    if (name.includes(token)) score += 1;
                }
            }
        }
        if (score > bestScore) {
            bestScore = score;
            best = node;
        }
    }
    return bestScore > 0 ? best : null;
}

function showLimitations(meta) {
    const unsupported = Array.isArray(meta.unsupportedExtensions) ? meta.unsupportedExtensions : [];
    const parseSummary = meta.parseSummary || {};
    const totalFiles = Number(meta.totalFiles || 0);
    const partialCount = Number(parseSummary.partial || 0);
    const unsupportedCount = Number(parseSummary.unsupported || 0);
    const totalLimited = partialCount + unsupportedCount;
    if (unsupported.length === 0 && totalLimited === 0) return;

    const banner = document.getElementById('limitationsBanner');
    const extsEl = document.getElementById('lbExts');
    const titleEl = banner.querySelector('.lb-title');
    if (titleEl) {
        titleEl.textContent = totalFiles > 0
            ? `Parser Coverage: ${Math.max(0, totalFiles - unsupportedCount)}/${totalFiles}`
            : 'Parser Coverage';
    }
    const extText = unsupported.length > 0 ? `Unsupported extensions: ${unsupported.join(', ')}` : 'No unknown extensions detected';
    extsEl.textContent = `${extText} · Partial: ${partialCount} · Unsupported files: ${unsupportedCount}`;
    banner.style.display = 'block';

    const contactBtn = document.getElementById('contactBtn');
    contactBtn.style.display = unsupported.length > 0 ? 'block' : 'none';

    const textarea = document.getElementById('contactMessage');
    const repoUrl = document.getElementById('repoInput').value.trim();
    textarea.value = `Hi! I'd love CodeFly to support these file types:\n\n${unsupported.join(', ')}\n\nParse summary: partial=${partialCount}, unsupported=${unsupportedCount}\nRepo: ${repoUrl}\n\nThanks!`;
}

function walkDir(dir, skippedExts) {
  const results = [];
  let entries;
  try {
    entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
  } catch {
    return results;
  }
  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (entry.name.startsWith('.') && entry.isDirectory()) continue;
    const fullPath = path.join(dir, entry.name);
    const ext = path.extname(entry.name).toLowerCase();
    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
      if (shouldExcludeDir(entry.name)) continue;
      results.push(...walkDir(fullPath, skippedExts));
    } else if (SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS.has(ext) || FILENAME_LANG[entry.name]) {
      if (EXCLUDED_FILES.has(entry.name)) continue;
      const fileNameLang = FILENAME_LANG[entry.name];
      const extLang = LANG_CONFIG[ext] ? LANG_CONFIG[ext].lang : null;
      results.push({ fullPath, lang: extLang || fileNameLang, ext });
    } else {
      if (!entry.name.startsWith('.') && (ext === '' || !BINARY_EXTENSIONS.has(ext))) {
        if (ext) {
          skippedExts.add(ext);
        }
        results.push({ fullPath, lang: 'unknown', ext });
      }
    }
  }
  return results;
}

function escapeRegexLiteral(value) {
  return String(value).replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
}

function buildSymbolMatchers(names) {
  return names.map((name) => {
    const escaped = escapeRegexLiteral(name);
    return {
      name,
      call: new RegExp(`(^|[^\\w$])(?:new\\s+)?${escaped}\\s*\\(`),
      usage: new RegExp(`(^|[^\\w$])${escaped}([^\\w$]|$)`),
      declaration: new RegExp(`\\b(function|class|const|let|var|type|interface|enum|def|fn|func)\\s+${escaped}\\b`),
    };
  });
}

function extractSymbolReferences(content, knownDefinitions) {
  if (typeof content !== 'string' || content.length === 0 || !Array.isArray(knownDefinitions)) return [];
  const names = [...new Set(knownDefinitions.map((def) => def.name).filter(Boolean))];
  if (names.length === 0) return [];
  const refs = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  const matchers = buildSymbolMatchers(names);
  const lines = content.split('\n');

  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const line = lines[i];
    for (const matcher of matchers) {
      if (matcher.declaration.test(line)) continue;
      if (!matcher.call.test(line) && !matcher.usage.test(line)) continue;
      const key = `${matcher.name}@${i + 1}`;
      if (seen.has(key)) continue;
      seen.add(key);
      refs.push({ name: matcher.name, line: i + 1 });
    }
  }
  return refs;
}

function findContainingDefinition(definitions, line) {
  if (!Array.isArray(definitions) || definitions.length === 0) return null;
  const sorted = [...definitions].sort((a, b) => a.line - b.line);
  let nearest = null;
  let nearestFunction = null;

  for (const def of sorted) {
    if (def.line > line) break;
    nearest = def;
    if (def.kind === 'function') nearestFunction = def;
  }
  return nearestFunction || nearest;
}

function buildSymbolDefinitionIndex(nodes) {
  const symbolIndex = new Map();
  for (const node of nodes) {
    for (const def of node.definitions || []) {
      if (!symbolIndex.has(def.name)) symbolIndex.set(def.name, []);
      symbolIndex.get(def.name).push({ file: node.id, def });
    }
  }
  return symbolIndex;
}

function buildDefinitionsByFile(nodes) {
  const definitionsByFile = new Map();
  for (const node of nodes) {
    definitionsByFile.set(node.id, node.definitions || []);
  }
  return definitionsByFile;
}

function buildReferenceCandidates(fileId, definitionsByFile, importsByFile) {
  const byName = new Map();
  const addDefs = (defs) => {
    for (const def of defs || []) {
      if (!def || !def.name || byName.has(def.name)) continue;
      byName.set(def.name, def);
    }
  };

  addDefs(definitionsByFile.get(fileId));
  for (const importedFile of importsByFile.get(fileId) || []) {
    addDefs(definitionsByFile.get(importedFile));
  }
  return Array.from(byName.values());
}

function resolveSymbolTargets(fromFile, refName, symbolIndex, importsByFile) {
  const candidates = symbolIndex.get(refName) || [];
  if (candidates.length === 0) return [];
  const sameFile = candidates.filter((candidate) => candidate.file === fromFile);
  if (sameFile.length > 0) return sameFile;
  const importedFiles = importsByFile.get(fromFile) || new Set();
  return candidates.filter((candidate) => importedFiles.has(candidate.file));
}

function addSymbolEdge(symbolEdges, seen, fromFile, sourceDef, target, callLine) {
  if (fromFile === target.file && sourceDef.name === target.def.name) return;
  const key = `${fromFile}|${sourceDef.name}|${target.file}|${target.def.name}|${callLine}`;
  if (seen.has(key)) return;
  seen.add(key);
  symbolEdges.push({
    fromFile,
    toFile: target.file,
    fromSymbol: sourceDef.name,
    toSymbol: target.def.name,
    fromKind: sourceDef.kind || 'function',
    toKind: target.def.kind || 'function',
    fromLine: sourceDef.line || 0,
    toLine: target.def.line || 0,
    callLine,
    type: 'static-call',
  });
}

function buildSymbolEdges(nodes, importsByFile, refsByFile) {
  const symbolEdges = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  const symbolIndex = buildSymbolDefinitionIndex(nodes);
  const definitionsByFile = buildDefinitionsByFile(nodes);

  for (const node of nodes) {
    const content = refsByFile.get(node.id) || '';
    const candidates = buildReferenceCandidates(node.id, definitionsByFile, importsByFile);
    if (candidates.length === 0) continue;
    const refs = extractSymbolReferences(content, candidates);
    const definitions = node.definitions || [];
    for (const ref of refs) {
      const sourceDef = findContainingDefinition(definitions, ref.line);
      if (!sourceDef) continue;
      const targets = resolveSymbolTargets(node.id, ref.name, symbolIndex, importsByFile);
      for (const target of targets) {
        addSymbolEdge(symbolEdges, seen, node.id, sourceDef, target, ref.line);
      }
    }
  }
  return symbolEdges;
}

// ============================================================
// IMPORT RESOLUTION
// ============================================================
function resolveImport(importPath, fromFile, fileSet, lang, rootDir) {
  if (lang === 'python') {
    const pyPath = importPath.replace(/\./g, '/');
    const fromDir = path.dirname(fromFile);
    const candidates = [
      path.resolve(rootDir, pyPath + '.py'),
      path.resolve(rootDir, pyPath, '__init__.py'),
      path.resolve(fromDir, pyPath + '.py'),
      path.resolve(fromDir, pyPath, '__init__.py'),
    ];
    for (const c of candidates) {
      if (fileSet.has(c)) return c;
    }
    return null;
  }

  if (lang === 'javascript' || lang === 'typescript') {
    if (!importPath.startsWith('.') && !importPath.startsWith('/')) return null;
    const fromDir = path.dirname(fromFile);
    const resolved = path.resolve(fromDir, importPath);
    const exts = lang === 'typescript'
      ? ['', '.ts', '.tsx', '.js', '.jsx', '/index.ts', '/index.tsx', '/index.js']
      : ['', '.js', '.mjs', '.jsx', '/index.js'];
    for (const ext of exts) {
      if (fileSet.has(resolved + ext)) return resolved + ext;
    }
    return null;
  }

  if (lang === 'go') {
    return null;
  }

  if (lang === 'ruby') {
    if (!importPath.startsWith('.')) return null;
    const fromDir = path.dirname(fromFile);
    const resolved = path.resolve(fromDir, importPath);
    const candidates = [resolved, resolved + '.rb'];
    for (const c of candidates) {
      if (fileSet.has(c)) return c;
    }
    return null;
  }

  if (lang === 'c' || lang === 'cpp') {
    if (importPath.startsWith('<')) return null;
    const fromDir = path.dirname(fromFile);
    const resolved = path.resolve(fromDir, importPath);
    if (fileSet.has(resolved)) return resolved;
    return null;
  }

  if (lang === 'html' || lang === 'css' || lang === 'vue' || lang === 'svelte') {
    if (importPath.startsWith('http://') || importPath.startsWith('https://') || importPath.startsWith('//')) return null;
    const fromDir = path.dirname(fromFile);
    const resolved = path.resolve(fromDir, importPath);
    if (fileSet.has(resolved)) return resolved;
    return null;
  }

  return null;
}

function buildPreviewLines(content, maxLines = 8) {
  if (typeof content !== 'string' || content.length === 0) {
    return [];
  }
  return content
    .split('\n')
    .filter((line) => line.trim().length > 0)
    .slice(0, maxLines)
    .map((line) => (line.length > 120 ? line.substring(0, 120) + '...' : line));
}

function buildRawPreview(content, maxLines = 3) {
  if (typeof content !== 'string' || content.length === 0) {
    return [];
  }
  return content
    .split('\n')
    .slice(0, maxLines)
    .map((line) => (line.length > 180 ? line.substring(0, 180) + '...' : line));
}

function getParseProfile(file, content) {
  const lang = file.lang || 'unknown';
  const hasContent = typeof content === 'string' && content.length > 0;

  if (lang === 'unknown') {
    const extLabel = file.ext || 'unknown extension';
    return {
      parseStatus: PARSE_STATUS_UNSUPPORTED,
      parseReason: `No parser configured for ${extLabel}`,
    };
  }

  if (!hasContent) {
    return {
      parseStatus: PARSE_STATUS_PARTIAL,
      parseReason: 'Source content unavailable; showing file metadata only',
    };
  }

  if (PARTIAL_PARSE_LANGS.has(lang)) {
    return {
      parseStatus: PARSE_STATUS_PARTIAL,
      parseReason: `Lightweight parser mode for ${lang}`,
    };
  }

  return {
    parseStatus: PARSE_STATUS_FULL,
    parseReason: `Parser active for ${lang}`,
  };
}

// ============================================================
// GENERATE GRAPH (reusable function)
// ============================================================
/** @returns {GraphData} */
function generateGraph(directory) {
  const skippedExts = new Set();
  const allFiles = walkDir(directory, skippedExts);
  const fileSet = new Set(allFiles.map((file) => file.fullPath));

  const nodes = [];
  const edges = [];
  const importsByFile = new Map();
  const refsByFile = new Map();
  /** @type {Record<string, number>} */
  const langStats = {};
  const parseSummary = {
    [PARSE_STATUS_FULL]: 0,
    [PARSE_STATUS_PARTIAL]: 0,
    [PARSE_STATUS_UNSUPPORTED]: 0,
  };

  for (const file of allFiles) {
    const lang = file.lang || 'unknown';
    langStats[lang] = (langStats[lang] || 0) + 1;

    const relPath = path.relative(directory, file.fullPath);
    const folder = path.dirname(relPath).split(path.sep)[0] || '_root';

    let content = '';
    try {
      content = fs.readFileSync(file.fullPath, 'utf-8');
    } catch {
      content = '';
    }

    const allLines = content.length > 0 ? content.split('\n') : [];
    const lines = allLines.length;
    const { parseStatus, parseReason } = getParseProfile(file, content);
    parseSummary[parseStatus] = (parseSummary[parseStatus] || 0) + 1;

    const definitions = parseStatus === PARSE_STATUS_UNSUPPORTED || content.length === 0
      ? []
      : extractDefinitionsFromContent(content, lang);
    const imports = parseStatus === PARSE_STATUS_UNSUPPORTED || content.length === 0
      ? new Set()
      : extractImportsFromContent(content, lang);

    const previewLines = buildPreviewLines(content);
    const rawPreview = buildRawPreview(content);

    let fileSize = 0;
    try {
      fileSize = fs.statSync(file.fullPath).size;
    } catch {
      fileSize = 0;
    }

    nodes.push({
      id: relPath,
      label: path.basename(relPath),
      folder: folder,
      lines: lines,
      fullPath: relPath,
      definitions: definitions,
      lang: lang,
      preview: previewLines,
      rawPreview,
      content: content,
      parseStatus,
      parseReason,
      size: fileSize,
    });

    refsByFile.set(relPath, content);
    const resolvedImports = new Set();
    for (const imp of imports) {
      const resolved = resolveImport(imp, file.fullPath, fileSet, lang, directory);
      if (!resolved) continue;
      const targetRel = path.relative(directory, resolved);
      edges.push({ from: relPath, to: targetRel });
      resolvedImports.add(targetRel);
    }
    importsByFile.set(relPath, resolvedImports);
  }

  const symbolEdges = buildSymbolEdges(nodes, importsByFile, refsByFile);

  /** @type {GraphData} */
  const graphData = {
    nodes,
    edges,
    symbolEdges,
    meta: {
      languages: langStats,
      parseSummary,
      unsupportedExtensions: Array.from(skippedExts).sort(),
      totalFiles: allFiles.length,
      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    },
  };
  return graphData;
}

function cloneRepo(gitUrl) {
  const tmpDir = path.join(__dirname, '.tmp-repo-' + Date.now());
  execSync(`git clone --depth 1 ${gitUrl} ${tmpDir}`, { stdio: 'pipe' });
  return tmpDir;
}

module.exports = { generateGraph, cloneRepo };

  }

  let scanDir;

  if (needsCleanup) {
    fs.rmSync(scanDir, { recursive: true });
    console.log('Cleaned up cloned repo');

  const newHashes = {};
  for (const node of graphData.nodes) {

  console.log(`Nodes: ${graphData.nodes.length}`);
  console.log(`Edges: ${graphData.edges.length}`);
  console.log(`Languages:`, graphData.meta.languages);
  console.log(`Written to ${outputFile}`);
}

// Uses .cache/ directory for storing graph data and hashes

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const crypto = require('crypto');

const CACHE_DIR = path.join(__dirname, '.cache');

function ensureCacheDir() {
  if (!fs.existsSync(CACHE_DIR)) {
    fs.mkdirSync(CACHE_DIR, { recursive: true });
  }
}

function getRepoKey(repoUrl, branch = 'main') {
  const safe = repoUrl.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_');
  return `${safe}#${branch}`;
}

function getCachePath(repoKey, type) {
  ensureCacheDir();
  return path.join(CACHE_DIR, `${repoKey}.${type}.json`);
}

function saveCachedGraph(repoKey, graphData) {
  const cachePath = getCachePath(repoKey, 'graph');
  fs.writeFileSync(cachePath, JSON.stringify(graphData, null, 2));
}

function loadCachedGraph(repoKey) {
  const cachePath = getCachePath(repoKey, 'graph');
  if (!fs.existsSync(cachePath)) return null;
  try {
    const raw = fs.readFileSync(cachePath, 'utf8');
    return JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function saveCachedHashes(repoKey, hashMap) {
  const cachePath = getCachePath(repoKey, 'hashes');
  fs.writeFileSync(cachePath, JSON.stringify(hashMap, null, 2));
}

function loadCachedHashes(repoKey) {
  const cachePath = getCachePath(repoKey, 'hashes');
  if (!fs.existsSync(cachePath)) return null;
  try {
    const raw = fs.readFileSync(cachePath, 'utf8');
    return JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function deleteCache(repoKey) {
  const graphPath = getCachePath(repoKey, 'graph');
  const hashPath = getCachePath(repoKey, 'hashes');
  if (fs.existsSync(graphPath)) fs.unlinkSync(graphPath);
  if (fs.existsSync(hashPath)) fs.unlinkSync(hashPath);
}

function saveCache(repoKey, graphData, hashMap) {
  saveCachedGraph(repoKey, graphData);
  saveCachedHashes(repoKey, hashMap);
}

function loadCache(repoKey) {
  const graphData = loadCachedGraph(repoKey);
  const hashMap = loadCachedHashes(repoKey);
  if (!graphData || !hashMap) return null;
  return { graphData, hashMap };
}

function computeHash(content) {
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(content || '').digest('hex');
}

module.exports = {
  getRepoKey,
  saveCachedGraph,
  loadCachedGraph,
  saveCachedHashes,
  loadCachedHashes,
  deleteCache,
  saveCache,
  loadCache,
  computeHash,
};

// Uses IndexedDB for graphData (large) and localStorage for file hashes (small)

const DB_NAME = 'codefly-graph-cache';
const DB_VERSION = 1;
const STORE_NAME = 'graphs';
const HASH_PREFIX = 'codefly-hashes-';

function getRepoKey(repoUrl, branch = 'main') {
  return `${repoUrl}#${branch}`;
}

// IndexedDB operations
async function openDB() {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const request = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);
    request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
    request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
    request.onupgradeneeded = (event) => {
      const db = event.target.result;
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_NAME)) {
        db.createObjectStore(STORE_NAME);
      }
    };
  });
}

async function saveCachedGraph(repoKey, graphData) {
  const db = await openDB();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
    const request = store.put(graphData, repoKey);
    request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
    request.onsuccess = () => resolve();
  });
}

async function loadCachedGraph(repoKey) {
  const db = await openDB();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readonly');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
    const request = store.get(repoKey);
    request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
    request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result || null);
  });
}

async function deleteCachedGraph(repoKey) {
  const db = await openDB();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
    const request = store.delete(repoKey);
    request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
    request.onsuccess = () => resolve();
  });
}

// localStorage hash operations
function saveCachedHashes(repoKey, hashMap) {
  const key = HASH_PREFIX + repoKey;
  localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(hashMap));
}

function loadCachedHashes(repoKey) {
  const key = HASH_PREFIX + repoKey;
  const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
  if (!raw) return null;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function deleteCachedHashes(repoKey) {
  const key = HASH_PREFIX + repoKey;
  localStorage.removeItem(key);
}

// Combined operations
async function saveCache(repoKey, graphData, hashMap) {
  await saveCachedGraph(repoKey, graphData);
  saveCachedHashes(repoKey, hashMap);
}

async function loadCache(repoKey) {
  const [graphData, hashMap] = await Promise.all([
    loadCachedGraph(repoKey),
    Promise.resolve(loadCachedHashes(repoKey)),
  ]);
  return { graphData, hashMap };
}

async function deleteCache(repoKey) {
  await deleteCachedGraph(repoKey);
  deleteCachedHashes(repoKey);
}

// Hash computation
async function computeHash(content) {
  const encoder = new TextEncoder();
  const data = encoder.encode(content);
  const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', data);
  const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));
  return hashArray.map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}

// Export for use in explorer.js and generate-graph.js
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
  module.exports = {
    getRepoKey,
    saveCachedGraph,
    loadCachedGraph,
    deleteCachedGraph,
    saveCachedHashes,
    loadCachedHashes,
    deleteCachedHashes,
    saveCache,
    loadCache,
    deleteCache,
    computeHash,
  };
}

      "content": "# Feature Planning Checklist\n\n## Before Coding Any Feature\n\n### 1. Trace the Complete Data Flow\n- [ ] Input: Where does data come from? (user input, API, storage)\n- [ ] Validation: What validates this data? Find ALL validation functions\n- [ ] Transformation: What transforms/format this data?\n- [ ] Processing: What processes this data? (API calls, business logic)\n- [ ] Storage: Where is this data stored? (localStorage, state)\n- [ ] Output: How is this data displayed/used?\n- [ ] Error handling: What happens when something fails?\n\n### 2. Identify All Integration Points\n- [ ] UI components that display/collect data\n- [ ] Validation functions\n- [ ] API endpoints (internal and external)\n- [ ] Storage mechanisms\n- [ ] Event handlers\n- [ ] State management\n- [ ] Navigation/routing\n\n### 3. Search for Existing Patterns\n- [ ] Grep for similar functionality already implemented\n- [ ] Check how similar features handle validation\n- [ ] Look for existing utility functions\n- [ ] Review CSS patterns for similar UI elements\n\n### 4. Consider Edge Cases\n- [ ] Empty/missing data\n- [ ] Network failures\n- [ ] Rate limits\n- [ ] Large datasets (pagination)\n- [ ] User permissions\n- [ ] Browser compatibility\n\n### 5. Update Plan Based on Findings\n- [ ] List all files that need modification\n- [ ] Identify new functions needed\n- [ ] Note any refactoring required\n- [ ] Plan error messages and user feedback\n\n## Example: Repository Browser Feature\n\n### Data Flow Trace\n1. PRODUCT OVERVIEW\n\nCodeFly is a **3D first-person codebase explorer**. Type a GitHub/GitLab URL or pick a local folder — the entire codebase renders as a navigable 3D graph in the browser. Files are glowing spheres connected by dependency edges. Folders are color-coded clusters. Functions and variables orbit their parent file node as smaller octahedra. FOLDER APPEARANCE CUSTOMIZATION\n\n### 5.1 Concept\n\nEach folder is currently assigned a color deterministically via `getFolderColor(folder)` (hash-based, returns a hex integer). Users should be able to:\n- Change the color of any folder (color picker)\n- Change the visual shape of nodes within a folder (sphere, cube, diamond, cylinder)\n- Hide/show all files in a folder (collapse/expand)\n- These preferences persist in `localStorage` under key `'codefly_folder_prefs_v1'`\n\n### 5.2 Folder Preferences Storage (explorer.js)\n\nAdd these four functions. Place them near the analytics section (around line 1800):\n\n```javascript\nconst FOLDER_PREFS_KEY = 'codefly_folder_prefs_v1';\n\nfunction getFolderPrefs(folder) {\n  try {\n    const all = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(FOLDER_PREFS_KEY) || '{}');\n    return all[folder] || {};\n  } catch {\n    return {};\n  }\n}\n\nfunction saveFolderPref(folder, key, value) {\n  try {\n    const all = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(FOLDER_PREFS_KEY) || '{}');\n    if (!all[folder]) all[folder] = {};\n    all[folder][key] = value;\n    localStorage.setItem(FOLDER_PREFS_KEY, JSON.stringify(all));\n  } catch {\n    throw new Error(`Failed to save folder preference for \"${folder}\"`);\n  }\n}\n\nfunction setFolderColor(folder, hexColor) {\n  saveFolderPref(folder, 'color', hexColor);\n  const colorInt = parseInt(hexColor.replace('#', ''), 16);\n  for (const [id, mesh] of nodeMeshes) {\n    if (!mesh.userData.nodeData) continue;\n    if (mesh.userData.nodeData.folder !== folder) continue;\n    mesh.material.color.setHex(colorInt);\n    mesh.material.emissive.setHex(colorInt);\n    mesh.userData.baseColor = colorInt;\n    // Update glow child\n    for (const child of mesh.children) {\n      if (child.isMesh && child.material && child.material.transparent) {\n        child.material.color.setHex(colorInt);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nfunction setFolderShape(folder, shape) {\n  const VALID_SHAPES = ['sphere', 'cube', 'diamond', 'cylinder'];\n  if (!VALID_SHAPES.includes(shape)) {\n    throw new Error(`setFolderShape: invalid shape \"${shape}\". Must be one of: ${VALID_SHAPES.join(', ')}`);\n  }\n  saveFolderPref(folder, 'shape', shape);\n\n  for (const [id, mesh] of nodeMeshes) {\n    if (!mesh.userData.nodeData) continue;\n    if (mesh.userData.nodeData.folder !== folder) continue;\n\n    const size = mesh.userData.baseSize;\n    let newGeo;\n    if (shape === 'sphere')   newGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(size, 16, 16);\n    else if (shape === 'cube')     newGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size * 1.5, size * 1.5, size * 1.5);\n    else if (shape === 'diamond')  newGeo = new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(size * 1.2, 0);\n    else if (shape === 'cylinder') newGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(size * 0.8, size * 0.8, size * 2, 12);\n\n    mesh.geometry.dispose();\n    mesh.geometry = newGeo;\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 5.3 Apply Saved Prefs on Graph Build\n\nIn `buildGraph()` in `explorer.js`, after `nodeMeshes.set(node.id, mesh)` and after the glow/label/indicator children are added, apply saved preferences:\n\n```javascript\n// Apply saved folder preferences (color, shape)\nconst savedPrefs = getFolderPrefs(node.folder);\nif (savedPrefs.color) {\n  const colorInt = parseInt(savedPrefs.color.replace('#', ''), 16);\n  mat.color.setHex(colorInt);\n  mat.emissive.setHex(colorInt);\n  mesh.userData.baseColor = colorInt;\n}\nif (savedPrefs.shape && savedPrefs.shape !== 'sphere') {\n  // Defer shape change until after mesh is in scene\n  setTimeout(() => setFolderShape(node.folder, savedPrefs.shape), 0);\n}\n```\n\n**Note:** The `setTimeout` is needed because `setFolderShape` iterates `nodeMeshes` — calling it mid-loop would only affect already-added meshes. Using `setTimeout(fn, 0)` defers until after `buildGraph()` completes. This is the correct approach.\n\n### 5.4 Folder Settings Panel (index.html)\n\nAdd this HTML element inside `<body>`, after `#analyticsPanel`:\n\n```html\n<div id=\"folderSettingsPanel\"\n     style=\"display:none; position:fixed; top:50%; left:50%; transform:translate(-50%,-50%);\n            background:#0a0a1a; border:1px solid #333; border-radius:12px; padding:24px;\n            z-index:200; min-width:380px; max-height:80vh; overflow-y:auto;\n            font-family:'Courier New',monospace; box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);\">\n  <div style=\"color:#fff; font-size:15px; font-weight:bold; margin-bottom:16px; letter-spacing:1px;\">\n    📁 FOLDER APPEARANCE\n  </div>\n  <div id=\"folderSettingsList\"></div>\n  <button onclick=\"closeFolderSettings()\"\n          style=\"margin-top:16px; padding:8px 20px; background:transparent; color:#555;\n                 border:1px solid #333; border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer;\n                 font-family:'Courier New',monospace; font-size:12px;\">\n    Close\n  </button>\n</div>\n```\n\n### 5.5 `openFolderSettings()` and `closeFolderSettings()` (explorer.js)\n\n```javascript\nfunction openFolderSettings() {\n  if (!gameStarted) throw new Error('openFolderSettings: game not started');\n  if (!graphData) throw new Error('openFolderSettings: no graph data loaded');\n\n  const panel = document.getElementById('folderSettingsPanel');\n  const list = document.getElementById('folderSettingsList');\n  if (!panel || !list) throw new Error('Folder settings panel elements missing from DOM');\n\n  const folders = [...new Set(graphData.nodes.map((n) => n.folder))].sort();\n  list.innerHTML = '';\n\n  for (const folder of folders) {\n    const prefs = getFolderPrefs(folder);\n    const defaultColorHex = '#' + getFolderColor(folder).toString(16).padStart(6, '0');\n    const nodeCount = graphData.nodes.filter((n) => n.folder === folder).length;\n\n    const row = document.createElement('div');\n    row.style.cssText = 'display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; margin-bottom:12px; padding-bottom:12px; border-bottom:1px solid #111;';\n\n    // Folder name + file count\n    const nameEl = document.createElement('span');\n    nameEl.style.cssText = 'color:#ccc; font-size:12px; width:140px; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; flex-shrink:0;';\n    nameEl.textContent = `${folder} (${nodeCount})`;\n    nameEl.title = folder;\n\n    // Color picker\n    const colorInput = document.createElement('input');\n    colorInput.type = 'color';\n    colorInput.value = prefs.color || defaultColorHex;\n    colorInput.style.cssText = 'width:32px; height:26px; border:none; cursor:pointer; border-radius:4px; flex-shrink:0;';\n    colorInput.title = 'Change folder color';\n    colorInput.oninput = () => setFolderColor(folder, colorInput.value);\n\n    // Shape selector\n    const shapeSelect = document.createElement('select');\n    shapeSelect.style.cssText = 'background:#111; color:#ccc; border:1px solid #333; border-radius:4px; padding:3px 6px; font-family:Courier New,monospace; font-size:11px; flex-shrink:0;';\n    shapeSelect.title = 'Change node shape';\n    for (const shape of ['sphere', 'cube', 'diamond', 'cylinder']) {\n      const opt = document.createElement('option');\n      opt.value = shape;\n      opt.textContent = shape;\n      if ((prefs.shape || 'sphere') === shape) opt.selected = true;\n      shapeSelect.appendChild(opt);\n    }\n    shapeSelect.onchange = () => setFolderShape(folder, shapeSelect.value);\n\n    // Hide/Show toggle\n    const toggleBtn = document.createElement('button');\n    const isCollapsed = collapsedFolders.has(folder);\n    toggleBtn.textContent = isCollapsed ? 'Show' : 'Hide';\n    toggleBtn.style.cssText = 'padding:3px 10px; background:transparent; color:#888; border:1px solid #444; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; font-family:Courier New,monospace; font-size:10px; flex-shrink:0;';\n    toggleBtn.onclick = () => {\n      toggleFolderCollapse(folder);\n      toggleBtn.textContent = collapsedFolders.has(folder) ? 'Show' : 'Hide';\n    };\n\n    row.appendChild(nameEl);\n    row.appendChild(colorInput);\n    row.appendChild(shapeSelect);\n    row.appendChild(toggleBtn);\n    list.appendChild(row);\n  }\n\n  panel.style.display = 'block';\n  document.exitPointerLock();\n}\n\nwindow.closeFolderSettings = function() {\n  const panel = document.getElementById('folderSettingsPanel');\n  if (!panel) throw new Error('folderSettingsPanel element missing from DOM');\n  panel.style.display = 'none';\n};\n```\n\n### 5.6 Keyboard Shortcut\n\nIn `setupControls()` keydown handler, add:\n```javascript\nif (key === 'p' && gameStarted) {\n  const panel = document.getElementById('folderSettingsPanel');\n  if (panel.style.display === 'block') {\n    window.closeFolderSettings();\n  } else {\n    openFolderSettings();\n  }\n}\n```\n\nUpdate controls hint in `#hud`:\n```html\n<div><span class=\"key\">P</span> Folder styles | <span class=\"key\">V</span> Orbit/Stack</div>\n```\n\n---\n\n## 6. MULTIPLAYER — CLOUDFLARE DURABLE OBJECTS\n\n### 6.1 Architecture Overview\n\nEach unique repo URL becomes a **Durable Object instance** (a persistent WebSocket room). When two users load the same GitHub repo, they connect to the same Durable Object and see each other in real-time.\n\nThe Cloudflare Worker lives in `/multiplayer/` and is deployed separately from the main app.\n\n### 6.2 Cloudflare Worker Files (already written — do not recreate)\n\n**`multiplayer/wrangler.toml`:**\n```toml\nname = \"codefly-multiplayer\"\nmain = \"src/index.js\"\ncompatibility_date = \"2024-01-01\"\ncompatibility_flags = [\"nodejs_compat\"]\n\n[[durable_objects.bindings]]\nname = \"ROOMS\"\nclass_name = \"Room\"\n\n[[migrations]]\ntag = \"v1\"\nnew_classes = [\"Room\"]\n```\n\n**`multiplayer/src/index.js`:** Worker entry point. Routes `GET /room/:roomId` (WebSocket upgrade) to a Room Durable Object. Returns CORS headers for OPTIONS preflight. Returns a 200 text response for any other path.\n\n**`multiplayer/src/room.js`:** Room Durable Object. Stores sessions in `Map<connId, { ws, presence }>`. Handles:\n- `presence` message → updates stored presence, broadcasts `presence_snapshot` to all other connections\n- `chat` message → broadcasts to all connections\n- WebSocket close → removes session, broadcasts `leave`\n\n### 6.3 WebSocket Message Protocol\n\n**Client → Server:**\n```json\n{ \"type\": \"presence\", \"x\": 12.4, \"y\": 5.1, \"z\": -33.2, \"yaw\": 1.2, \"nickname\": \"chen\", \"color\": \"hsl(200,80%,60%)\", \"nodeId\": \"src/auth.js\" }\n{ \"type\": \"chat\", \"text\": \"look at this file\", \"nickname\": \"chen\", \"color\": \"hsl(200,80%,60%)\" }\n```\n\n**Server → Client:**\n```json\n{ \"type\": \"presence_snapshot\", \"users\": [{ \"id\": \"uuid\", \"x\": 12.4, \"y\": 5.1, \"z\": -33.2, \"yaw\": 1.2, \"nickname\": \"chen\", \"color\": \"hsl(200,80%,60%)\", \"nodeId\": \"src/auth.js\" }] }\n{ \"type\": \"chat\", \"id\": \"uuid\", \"nickname\": \"chen\", \"color\": \"hsl(200,80%,60%)\", \"text\": \"look at this file\", \"ts\": 1234567890 }\n{ \"type\": \"leave\", \"id\": \"uuid\" }\n```\n\n### 6.4 `connectMultiplayer()` — full implementation (explorer.js)\n\nThis replaces the old implementation that used a local WebSocket server via `<meta name=\"ws-port\">`. The new version connects to the Cloudflare Worker.\n\n```javascript\n// Set this to your deployed Cloudflare Worker URL after `wrangler deploy`\n// e.g. 'https://codefly-multiplayer.yourname.workers.dev'\n// Set in index.html as: window.CODEFLY_MULTIPLAYER_HOST = '...'\nconst MULTIPLAYER_HOST = window.CODEFLY_MULTIPLAYER_HOST || '';\n\nfunction connectMultiplayer() {\n  if (!MULTIPLAYER_HOST) {\n    document.getElementById('onlineCount').textContent = '1';\n    return;\n  }\n\n  if (!graphData || !graphData.meta || !graphData.meta.repo) {\n    document.getElementById('onlineCount').textContent = '1';\n    return;\n  }\n\n  if (graphData.meta.provider === 'local') {\n    document.getElementById('onlineCount').textContent = '1';\n    return;\n  }\n\n  const roomId = encodeURIComponent(graphData.meta.repo);\n  const wsUrl = `${MULTIPLAYER_HOST.replace(/^http/, 'ws')}/room/${roomId}`;\n\n  ws = new WebSocket(wsUrl);\n\n  ws.onopen = () => {\n    wsReconnectDelay = 1000;\n    document.getElementById('onlineCount').textContent = '1';\n    sendPositionUpdate(); // announce ourselves immediately\n  };\n\n  ws.onmessage = (event) => {\n    let msg;\n    try {\n      msg = JSON.parse(event.data);\n    } catch {\n      return; // ignore malformed messages\n    }\n\n    if (msg.type === 'presence_snapshot') {\n      if (!Array.isArray(msg.users)) return;\n\n      const incomingIds = new Set(msg.users.map((u) => u.id));\n\n      // Remove players who are no longer in the snapshot\n      for (const [id] of remotePlayers) {\n        if (!incomingIds.has(id)) {\n          removeRemotePlayer(id);\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Add or update players\n      for (const user of msg.users) {\n        if (!user.id || !user.nickname) continue;\n        if (user.id === myPlayerId) continue; // skip ourselves\n\n        if (!remotePlayers.has(user.id)) {\n          createRemotePlayer({\n            id: user.id,\n            nickname: user.nickname,\n            color: user.color,\n            position: { x: user.x, y: user.y, z: user.z },\n          });\n          addChatMessage(`${user.nickname} is here`, '#0f8');\n        } else {\n          updateRemotePlayer(\n            user.id,\n            { x: user.x, y: user.y, z: user.z },\n            { yaw: user.yaw },\n            user.nickname\n          );\n        }\n      }\n\n      updateOnlineCount();\n    }\n\n    if (msg.type === 'chat') {\n      if (!msg.nickname || !msg.text) return;\n      addChatMessage(`${msg.nickname}: ${msg.text}`, '#8ff');\n    }\n\n    if (msg.type === 'leave') {\n      if (!msg.id) return;\n      removeRemotePlayer(msg.id);\n      updateOnlineCount();\n    }\n  };\n\n  ws.onclose = () => {\n    document.getElementById('onlineCount').textContent = '0';\n    const delay = Math.min(wsReconnectDelay, 30000);\n    setTimeout(connectMultiplayer, delay);\n    wsReconnectDelay = Math.min(wsReconnectDelay * 2, 30000);\n  };\n\n  ws.onerror = () => {}; // onclose will fire after onerror, handles reconnect\n}\n```\n\n### 6.5 `sendPositionUpdate()` — updated implementation (explorer.js)\n\nCalled every 3 frames from `animate()`. Sends current position, yaw, nickname, color, and hovered node ID.\n\n```javascript\nfunction sendPositionUpdate() {\n  if (!ws || ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) return;\n  ws.send(JSON.stringify({\n    type: 'presence',\n    x: playerGroup.position.x,\n    y: playerGroup.position.y,\n    z: playerGroup.position.z,\n    yaw: playerYaw,\n    nickname: myNickname,\n    color: myColor,\n    nodeId: hoveredNodeId || null,\n  }));\n}\n```\n\n### 6.6 `sendChat(text)` — updated implementation (explorer.js)\n\n```javascript\nfunction sendChat(text) {\n  if (!ws || ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) return;\n  ws.send(JSON.stringify({\n    type: 'chat',\n    text,\n    nickname: myNickname,\n    color: myColor,\n  }));\n  addChatMessage(`${myNickname}: ${text}`, '#0f8');\n}\n```\n\n### 6.7 Remote Player Rendering\n\n`createRemotePlayer(data)` creates a `THREE.Group` with:\n- **Body:** `CapsuleGeometry(0.3, 0.8, 4, 8)` in player color, `MeshPhongMaterial` with `emissiveIntensity: 0.3`\n- **Head:** `SphereGeometry(0.35, 12, 12)` white with color emissive, `emissiveIntensity: 0.2`\n- **Glow:** `SphereGeometry(1.2, 8, 8)` transparent `opacity: 0.08` in player color\n- **Label:** `createTextSprite(nickname, color, 24)` at `y=2.5`, `scale.set(4, 2, 1)`\n\n`data.color` is an HSL string like `\"hsl(200,80%,60%)\"`. `hslToHex(hslStr)` converts it to a Three.js hex integer.\n\n`updateRemotePlayer(playerId, position, rotation, nickname)`:\n- Lerps `group.position` toward `{x,y,z}` with factor `0.15`\n- Slerps `group.quaternion` toward yaw quaternion with factor `0.15`\n- If nickname changed, calls `updateRemotePlayerLabel(playerId)`\n\n`removeRemotePlayer(playerId)`:\n- Calls `addChatMessage(`${rp.nickname} left`, '#f88')`\n- Calls `scene.remove(rp.group)`\n- Deletes from `remotePlayers` Map\n\n`updateOnlineCount()`:\n- Sets `#onlineCount` to `remotePlayers.size + 1`\n- Rebuilds `#playerListItems` with one div per player (you + all remote)\n\n### 6.8 Minimap: Remote Players\n\nIn `updateMinimap()`, remote players are drawn as magenta dots:\n```javascript\nfor (const [id, rp] of remotePlayers) {\n  const rpx = (rp.group.position.x - px) * scale;\n  const rpz = (rp.group.position.z - pz) * scale;\n  ctx.fillStyle = '#f0f';\n  ctx.beginPath();\n  ctx.arc(cx + rpx, cy + rpz, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n  ctx.fill();\n}\n```\n\n### 6.9 Config in index.html\n\n```javascript\nwindow.CODEFLY_MULTIPLAYER_HOST = ''; // set to Worker URL after deploy\n```\n\n### 6.10 Deployment Steps\n\n```bash\ncd /path/to/code-explorer/multiplayer\nnpx wrangler@latest login    # opens browser to authenticate with Cloudflare\nnpx wrangler@latest deploy   # deploys, prints Worker URL\n```\n\nAfter deploy, set `window.CODEFLY_MULTIPLAYER_HOST` in `index.html` to the printed URL.\n\n---\n\n## 7. AUTHENTICATION\n\n### 7.1 Config Block (index.html)\n\n```javascript\nwindow.CODECHAT_OAUTH = {\n  githubClientId: '',    // GitHub OAuth App Client ID (Device Flow)\n  gitlabClientId: '',    // GitLab OAuth App Application ID (PKCE)\n  gitlabRedirectUri: window.location.origin + window.location.pathname,\n};\nwindow.CODEFLY_MULTIPLAYER_HOST = '';\n```\n\n### 7.2 Auth State (explorer.js)\n\n```javascript\nconst AUTH_STORAGE_KEY = 'codechat_auth_v1';\nlet authState = { provider: null, token: null, userLabel: null };\n```\n\n**`loadAuthState()`** — called on page load. Reads from `localStorage.getItem(AUTH_STORAGE_KEY)`. Parses JSON. If parse fails, sets `authState` to `{ provider: null, token: null, userLabel: null }`. Calls `updateAuthUi()`.\n\n**`saveAuthState()`** — writes `JSON.stringify(authState)` to `localStorage.setItem(AUTH_STORAGE_KEY, ...)`. Calls `updateAuthUi()`.\n\n**`updateAuthUi()`** — updates `#authStatus` text and CSS class:\n- If `!authState.provider || !authState.token`: text = `'Not connected — public repos work without login'`, class = `'logged-out'`, hide `#logoutBtn`\n- Else: text = `'🐙 Connected as [userLabel]'` (GitHub) or `'🦊 Connected as [userLabel]'` (GitLab), class = `'logged-in'`, show `#logoutBtn`\n\n**`getGitHubTokenForApi()`** — returns `authState.token` if `authState.provider === 'github'`, else `null`.\n\n**`getGitLabTokenForApi()`** — returns `authState.token` if `authState.provider === 'gitlab'`, else `null`.\n\n**`window.logoutAuth()`** — sets `authState = { provider: null, token: null, userLabel: null }`, calls `saveAuthState()`.\n\n### 7.3 `getOAuthConfig()` (explorer.js)\n\n```javascript\nfunction getOAuthConfig() {\n  const cfg = window.CODECHAT_OAUTH;\n  if (!cfg) {\n    return {\n      githubClientId: '',\n      gitlabClientId: '',\n      gitlabRedirectUri: window.location.origin + window.location.pathname,\n    };\n  }\n  return cfg;\n}\n```\n\n### 7.4 GitHub Device Flow\n\n**`window.loginGitHub()`:**\n1. Call `getOAuthConfig()` → get `githubClientId`\n2. If `!githubClientId` → call `openPatModal('github')` and return\n3. POST `https://github.com/login/device/code` with body `client_id=...&scope=repo,read:user`, header `Accept: application/json`\n4. Parse response: `{ device_code, user_code, verification_uri, interval, expires_in }`\n5. Store in `githubDeviceFlow = { deviceCode, userCode, verificationUri, intervalSec: interval, expiresInSec: expires_in }`\n6. Show `#deviceFlowModal`: set `#deviceFlowCode` to `user_code`\n7. Poll `https://github.com/login/oauth/access_token` every `interval` seconds with `client_id`, `device_code`, `grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code`\n8. If response contains `access_token`: call `fetchGitHubViewerLogin(token)` to get username, set `authState = { provider: 'github', token, userLabel: username }`, call `saveAuthState()`, close modal\n9. If response contains `error: 'authorization_pending'` → continue polling\n10. If response contains `error: 'expired_token'` → show error, stop polling\n\n**`window.openDeviceFlowUrl()`** — opens `githubDeviceFlow.verificationUri` in new tab.\n\n**`window.closeDeviceFlow()`** — hides `#deviceFlowModal`, stops polling.\n\n**`fetchGitHubViewerLogin(token)`** — GraphQL query to `https://api.github.com/graphql`:\n```graphql\n{ viewer { login } }\n```\nReturns `login` string. Throws if response is not ok or `data.viewer.login` is missing.\n\n### 7.5 GitLab PKCE Flow\n\n**`window.loginGitLab()`:**\n1. Call `getOAuthConfig()` → get `gitlabClientId`, `gitlabRedirectUri`\n2. If `!gitlabClientId` → call `openPatModal('gitlab')` and return\n3. Generate `verifier` = 64 random URL-safe chars\n4. Generate `state` = 24 random URL-safe chars\n5. Compute `challenge = base64url(sha256(verifier))`\n6. Store `gitlabPkce = { verifier, state }`\n7. Redirect to:\n   ```\n   https://gitlab.com/oauth/authorize\n     ?client_id=...\n     &redirect_uri=...\n     &response_type=code\n     &scope=read_api+read_repository\n     &code_challenge=...\n     &code_challenge_method=S256\n     &state=...\n   ```\n\n**`completeGitLabOAuthFromUrl()`** — called on page load if URL contains `?code=...&state=...`:\n1. Read `code` and `state` from `new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)`\n2. Verify `state === gitlabPkce.state` (stored in `sessionStorage`)\n3. POST to `https://gitlab.com/oauth/token` with `client_id`, `code`, `redirect_uri`, `grant_type=authorization_code`, `code_verifier`\n4. Get `access_token` from response\n5. GET `https://gitlab.com/api/v4/user` with `Authorization: Bearer [token]`\n6. Get `username` from response\n7. Set `authState = { provider: 'gitlab', token: access_token, userLabel: username }`, call `saveAuthState()`\n8. GRAPH SCENE — `buildGraph()` (explorer.js ~line 721)\n\nCalls `layoutGraph()` → `{ positions, folderPositions }`.\n\n**Per node:**\n- `size = Math.max(0.5, Math.min(2.5, Math.sqrt(node.lines) * 0.1))`\n- `color = getFolderColor(node.folder)` (deterministic hash → hex int)\n- `SphereGeometry(size, 16, 16)` + `MeshPhongMaterial({ color, emissive: color, emissiveIntensity: 0.3, shininess: 30 })`\n- `mesh.userData = { nodeData: node, baseColor: color, baseSize: size, baseY: pos.y, isFileNode: true }`\n- Glow child: `SphereGeometry(size*1.5, 12, 12)`, `MeshBasicMaterial(color, transparent, opacity=0.1)`\n- Label child: `createTextSprite(node.label, color)` at `y=size+1.5`, `scale=(4,2,1)`\n- If `definitions.length > 0`: orange ring `RingGeometry(size*1.2, size*1.5, 24)` at `y=-size*0.9`, opacity 0.5\n\n**Per edge:**\n- `LineBasicMaterial(0x1a3a5a, transparent, opacity=0.25)`\n- `line.userData = { from: edge.from, to: edge.to }`\n- Pushed to `edgeLines[]`\n\n**Per folder pillar:**\n- `CylinderGeometry(0.3, 0.3, LAYER_HEIGHT*2, 8)`, `MeshBasicMaterial(color, transparent, opacity=0.15)`\n- Folder label sprite at `y = pos.y + LAYER_HEIGHT + 5`, `scale=(12,6,1)`\n\n**`layoutGraph(nodes, edges)`** (explorer.js ~line 575):\n- Groups nodes by folder. Places folders in a circle at radius `folderCount * SPREAD * 1.2`.\n- Within each folder: spiral arrangement with random Y offsets in `±LAYER_HEIGHT/2`.\n- 3 iterations of repulsion pass (min distance = `SPREAD * 1.5`, force = `(minDist - dist) * 0.3`).\n- Returns `{ positions: {[nodeId]: {x,y,z}}, folderPositions: {[folder]: {x,y,z}} }`\n- Constants: `SPREAD = 12`, `LAYER_HEIGHT = 30`\n\n---\n\n## 10. FUNCTION EXPANSION (explorer.js ~line 817)\n\n### `expandFunctions(nodeId)`\n- Creates `OctahedronGeometry(0.4, 0)` meshes for each definition\n- Colors: function=`0xff8800`, class=`0x00ccff`, variable=`0xcc66ff`\n- Orbit mode: placed at `cos/sin(angle) * orbitRadius` around parent\n- File layout mode: stacked at `x=parent.x+4`, `y=parent.y + (count/2-i)*2.2`\n- Each has a label sprite and a connection `Line` to parent\n- `fnMesh.userData = { isFunctionNode, functionName, functionLine, functionKind, parentNodeId, orbitAngle, orbitRadius, orbitIndex, orbitCount, fileLayoutIndex, fileLayoutCount }`\n- Calls `updateFunctionPanel(node)` to show `#functionPanel`\n\n### `collapseFunctions(nodeId)`\n- Removes all function meshes and lines from scene, disposes geometry/material\n- Hides `#functionPanel`\n\n### `updateFunctionOrbits()` — called every frame\n- `time = Date.now() * 0.00008` (slow rotation)\n- In orbit mode: `angle = orbitAngle + time`, Y bobs with `sin(time*0.4 + orbitIndex)*0.3`\n- Updates connection line geometry positions every frame\n- In file layout mode: positions are static (set at expand time), only line endpoints updated\n\n### `updateFunctionPanel(node)`\n- Shows `#functionPanel` with `node.fullPath` and list of definitions\n- Each definition item: `[cls/fn/var] name :line`, clickable → `openIdePicker(node, def.line)`\n\n---\n\n## 11. ANIMATE LOOP — `animate()` (explorer.js ~line 2349)\n\n```javascript\nfunction animate() {\n  requestAnimationFrame(animate);\n  frameCount++;\n  if (gameStarted && pageVisible) {\n    updateMovement();\n    updateFlyTarget();\n    updateHover();\n    if (frameCount % 2 === 0) updateMinimap();\n    updateFunctionOrbits();\n    const time = Date.now() * 0.001;\n    for (const [id, mesh] of nodeMeshes) {\n      if (mesh.userData.targetPos) {\n        // Layout transition animation\n        mesh.position.lerp(mesh.userData.targetPos, 0.08);\n        if (mesh.position.distanceTo(mesh.userData.targetPos) < 0.05) {\n          mesh.position.copy(mesh.userData.targetPos);\n          delete mesh.userData.targetPos;\n        }\n      } else {\n        // Normal bobbing\n        mesh.position.y = mesh.userData.baseY + Math.sin(time + mesh.position.x * 0.1) * 0.3;\n      }\n    }\n    if (frameCount % 3 === 0) sendPositionUpdate();\n  }\n  renderer.render(scene, camera);\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 15. ANALYTICS — `#analyticsPanel` (explorer.js ~line 1800)\n\nOpened with `G` key. `buildAnalyticsFilters()` populates language and folder filter buttons.\n\n**`highlightNodes(matchingIds, label)`:**\n- Matching: `opacity=1, emissiveIntensity=0.8, scale=1.5`\n- Non-matching: `opacity=0.08, emissiveIntensity=0.05, scale=0.5`\n- Edges both-match: `opacity=0.8, color=0x00ff88`; one-match: `opacity=0.15`; no-match: `opacity=0.02`\n\n**Filter functions:**\n- `filterOrphans()` — no inbound AND no outbound edges\n- `filterHubs()` — top 10% by total connections\n- `filterLargest()` — top 20 by `node.lines`\n- `filterCircular()` — nodes in cycles (DFS)\n- `showBlastRadius()` — nodes reachable from `selectedNodeId` within 3 outbound hops\n- `filterNoDefinitions()` — `definitions.length === 0`\n- `filterApiSurface()` — `adjacencyIn >= 5`\n- `filterHotPaths()` — `adjacencyIn + adjacencyOut >= 8`\n- `filterRiskZones()` — `lines > 200 && adjacencyIn >= 3`\n- `filterEntryPoints()` — top 10 by outbound count\n- `toggleChurnHeat()` — fetches last commit dates via GitHub API, colors nodes by recency (red=recent, blue=old)\n- `toggleBlameOverlay()` — fetches last author per file, shows name labels on nodes\n- `filterByKind(kind)` — nodes with at least one definition of that kind\n- `clearFilters()` — restores all nodes/edges to default\n\n**Folder collapse** (also used by folder settings panel):\n- `toggleFolderCollapse(folder)` — adds/removes from `collapsedFolders` Set, calls `applyFolderCollapse()`\n- `applyFolderCollapse()` — sets `mesh.visible` and `line.visible` based on `collapsedFolders`\n\n---\n\n## 17.       "content": "# CodeFly — PRD Part 5: Product UX Flows, Ownership, Lifecycle Contracts\n**Version:** 1.0 | **Date:** May 2026 | **Scope:** End-to-end user experience and feature lifecycle contracts\n\n---\n\n## 0. Purpose\n\nThis PRD defines the single authoritative UX contract for CodeFly.\n\nIt specifies:\n- user-visible flows\n- state ownership\n- execution ownership\n- deployment/runtime ownership\n- acceptance criteria\n- failure states\n\nThis is not a design brainstorm. This is implementation truth for the current app.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Product Principles (Non-negotiable)\n\n1. **Single authoritative state per concern**\n   - Auth state: `authState` (`provider`, `token`, `userLabel`) persisted by `AUTH_STORAGE_KEY`.\n   - Pending OAuth transaction state: `OAUTH_PENDING_KEY`.\n   - Graph structure state: `graphData` loaded once per repo/folder.\n   - Execution path source of truth: `graphData.symbolEdges` (fallback to `graphData.edges` only for legacy payloads).\n\n2. **Single lifecycle owner per concern**\n   - OAuth pending transaction lifecycle owner: `explorer.js` auth module.\n   - Graph extraction lifecycle owner: `graph-generator.js` and `generate-graph.js`.\n   - 3D rendering + interaction owner: `explorer.js`.\n   - UI shell owner: `index.html` + DOM handlers in `explorer.js`.\n\n3. **Fail-fast UX behavior**\n   - Invalid state/token/path must fail loudly with explicit error text.\n   - Do not silently continue with corrupt auth or missing graph data.\n\n4. **No dual-path product behavior**\n   - Do not keep multiple independent ways to compute execution paths in UI.\n   - Paths are graph data, not UI-inferred heuristics.\n\n---\n\n## 2. User Personas and Jobs To Be Done\n\n### Persona A — Solo engineer\n- Wants fast repository understanding.\n- Needs to locate files/functions quickly and inspect dependency flow.\n\n### Persona B — Team lead in review / planning\n- Wants to visualize architecture and blast radius.\n- Needs clear call/dependency paths to support decisions.\n\n### Persona C — Team in shared room session\n- Wants a legible dashboard with clear authentication status and repository context.\n- Needs repeatable flows with minimal confusion.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Primary Product Journeys\n\n### Journey 1 — Start and authenticate\n1. User opens app.\n2. User sees start sections: public repo input, local folder, private auth.\n3. User clicks GitHub or GitLab connect.\n4. OAuth redirect completes.\n5. App validates pending provider + state.\n6. App saves auth state.\n7. UI transitions to connected dashboard view.\n\n**Success outcome:** user sees provider badge, profile summary, and repository browser.\n\n---\n\n### Journey 2 — Load repository graph\n1. User picks repo from connected list OR pastes repo URL OR selects local folder.\n2. App generates graph.\n3. App initializes 3D explorer.\n4. Search index and interaction layers initialize.\n\n**Success outcome:** graph renders, camera control works, search opens, analytics panel responds.\n\n---\n\n### Journey 3 — Understand execution/dependency paths\n1. User clicks a file node or opens search (`Cmd+K` / `Ctrl+K`).\n2. User selects path result or file.\n3. Execution path panel shows `CALLS` and `CALLED BY`.\n4. Clicking a path row highlights source and target lanes and navigates target.\n\n**Success outcome:** user can traverse static execution flow across files quickly.\n\n---\n\n### Journey 4 — Exit secured session\n1. User clicks logout.\n2. App clears auth state and pending OAuth state.\n3. App resets repo browser UI state.\n4. App returns to unauthenticated start sections.\n\n**Success outcome:** no residual authenticated identity appears after logout.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Detailed UX Flow Spec\n\n## 4.1 Start Screen Flow (Unauthenticated)\n\n### Entry criteria\n- `authState.provider === null`\n- `authState.token === null`\n\n### Visible UI\n- `#publicRepoSection`\n- `#localFolderSection`\n- `#privateAuthSection`\n- hidden `#repoBrowser`\n\n### Exit events\n- successful OAuth callback\n- successful local folder load\n- successful public/private repo graph load\n\n### Error states\n- invalid URL\n- API failure during graph generation\n- folder permission denied\n\n---\n\n## 4.2 GitHub OAuth Flow\n\n### Authoritative state\n- pending transaction: `OAUTH_PENDING_KEY`\n- connected session: `AUTH_STORAGE_KEY`\n\n### Sequence\n1. `loginGitHub()` creates random `state`.\n2. pending transaction persisted.\n3. browser redirected to GitHub authorize URL.\n4. callback enters `completeOAuthFromUrl()`.\n5. provider routed to GitHub callback handler.\n6. state validated against pending transaction.\n7. token exchange via worker endpoint.\n8. user profile fetch.\n9. auth saved and URL cleaned.\n10. UI updates and GitHub repos fetched.\n\n### Must not happen\n- validating GitLab callback against GitHub state\n- leaving pending state after completed/failed flow\n- showing connected dashboard with empty token\n\n### Acceptance criteria\n- no false `Invalid OAuth state` when correct callback returns\n- no mixed-provider callback handling\n- URL cleaned after callback\n\n---\n\n## 4.3 GitLab OAuth Flow\n\nSame structure as GitHub flow, but provider is GitLab.\n\n### Acceptance criteria\n- state verification uses pending provider = `gitlab`\n- successful callback loads GitLab profile + repos\n- dashboard labels/badge reflect GitLab identity\n\n---\n\n## 4.4 Connected Dashboard Flow\n\n### Entry criteria\n- `authState.provider in {'github','gitlab'}`\n- valid token present\n\n### Visible UI\n- `#repoBrowser` visible\n- start sections hidden\n- profile card with provider badge\n- repo search + pagination controls\n\n### Core actions\n- search repos\n- paginate repos\n- select repo to load explorer\n- logout\n\n### Acceptance criteria\n- no public/local start sections visible while connected\n- provider identity visually clear\n\n---\n\n## 4.5 Repository Load Flow\n\n### Inputs\n- repository URL (public/private)\n- repo list selection\n- local directory handle\n\n### System behavior\n- run graph generation\n- validate `nodes` and `edges` presence\n- initialize scene + controls + overlays\n- build search indices\n\n### Failure behavior\n- show explicit load error message\n- keep user in recoverable state\n\n### Acceptance criteria\n- explorer launches without stale prior graph state\n- keyboard and pointer lock behavior works after load\n\n---\n\n## 4.6 Global Search Flow (`Cmd+K` / `Ctrl+K`)\n\n### Entry\n- shortcut keydown\n- overlay open\n\n### Result types\n- file\n- function\n- class\n- variable\n- path (symbol-level where available)\n\n### Interaction contract\n- selecting file/symbol flies to node\n- selecting path highlights lane and opens target context\n- intent mode (`?`) still supported\n\n### Acceptance criteria\n- fast response under normal graph sizes\n- clear result labels (`FILE`, `FN`, `CLS`, `VAR`, `PATH`)\n\n---\n\n## 4.7 Execution Path Panel Flow\n\n### Authoritative data source\n- primary: `graphData.symbolEdges`\n- fallback: `graphData.edges` (legacy only)\n\n### Panel sections\n- `CALLS` (outbound from selected file)\n- `CALLED BY` (inbound to selected file)\n\n### Row contract\nEach row includes:\n- source symbol\n- target symbol\n- line references\n- source file and target file\n\n### Row click behavior\n- highlight source file node\n- highlight target file node\n- highlight file-level lane if exists\n- fly to target file\n- keep panel visible\n\n### Acceptance criteria\n- panel reflects currently selected node\n- path click updates highlight deterministically\n\n---\n\n## 4.8 Logout Flow\n\n### Sequence\n1. clear `AUTH_STORAGE_KEY` state\n2. clear `OAUTH_PENDING_KEY`\n3. clear legacy provider-specific state keys\n4. clear repo arrays and pagination\n5. reset browser panel content\n6. show unauthenticated start sections\n\n### Acceptance criteria\n- no stale connected identity remains\n- subsequent login starts cleanly\n\n---\n\n## 5. Feature Inventory Matrix\n\n| Feature | Entry Point | Owner | Primary State | Success Signal |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n| Public repo load | URL input + load action | `explorer.js` + `graph-generator.js` | `graphData` | graph rendered |\n| Local folder load | local folder button | `explorer.js` + `graph-generator.js` | `graphData` | graph rendered |\n| GitHub OAuth | connect GitHub | `explorer.js` auth flow | `OAUTH_PENDING_KEY`, `authState` | dashboard + repos shown |\n| GitLab OAuth | connect GitLab | `explorer.js` auth flow | `OAUTH_PENDING_KEY`, `authState` | dashboard + repos shown |\n| Repo browser | connected dashboard | `explorer.js` | repo arrays + pagination | selectable repos listed |\n| Search overlay | `Cmd+K` / `Ctrl+K` | `explorer.js` | `searchIndex`, path index | clickable results |\n| Execution path panel | node select / path result | `explorer.js` | `graphData.symbolEdges` | `CALLS` + `CALLED BY` rows |\n| Blast radius | analytics panel | `explorer.js` | adjacency lists | highlighted impacted files |\n| IDE open | hover/panel | `explorer.js` | selected node metadata | editor or remote URL opens |\n| Landmarks | analytics panel / shortcuts | `explorer.js` | saved landmarks storage | tour playback works |\n\n---\n\n## 6. UX Failure-State Contracts\n\n1. **OAuth state mismatch**\n   - Show explicit error.\n   - Clear callback URL params.\n   - Keep app in unauthenticated safe state.\n\n2. **Token exchange failure**\n   - Show provider-specific failure reason.\n   - Clear pending OAuth transaction.\n\n3. **Graph generation returns invalid shape**\n   - Throw explicit error and show load error banner.\n\n4. **Path data absent**\n   - If legacy graph: fallback to file-level edges.\n   - If malformed graph claiming symbol edges but invalid: fail and show explicit path data error.\n\n5. **Local folder denied**\n   - Preserve start screen, show actionable error.\n\n---\n\n## 7. Instrumentation Events (Required)\n\nTrack events for product visibility:\n- `auth_start` (`provider`)\n- `auth_success` (`provider`, `userLabel`)\n- `auth_failure` (`provider`, `reason`)\n- `repo_list_loaded` (`provider`, `count`)\n- `repo_load_start` (`source`: public/url/list/local)\n- `repo_load_success` (`provider`, `nodes`, `edges`)\n- `repo_load_failure` (`reason`)\n- `search_opened`\n- `search_result_selected` (`type`)\n- `execution_path_opened` (`nodeId`)\n- `execution_path_row_selected` (`fromFile`, `toFile`, `fromSymbol`, `toSymbol`)\n- `logout`\n\n---\n\n## 8. Release Readiness Checklist\n\n- [ ] GitHub OAuth flow deterministic and clean\n- [ ] GitLab OAuth flow deterministic and clean\n- [ ] Connected dashboard hides start-screen sections\n- [ ] Repo browser profile + repos render for both providers\n- [ ] Search overlay returns all result types\n- [ ] Execution path panel driven by symbol edges where available\n- [ ] Legacy payload fallback still works\n- [ ] Logout fully resets identity and pending OAuth\n- [ ] No blocking regressions in explorer navigation\n\n---\n\n## 9. Out of Scope (for this PRD)\n\n- Runtime tracing / runtime call stack capture\n- Per-function 3D node rendering as first-class graph entities\n- Multi-provider simultaneous auth session\n\n---\n\n## 10. Definition of Done\n\nThis PRD is satisfied when:\n1. Every listed flow is implemented exactly once with clear owner.\n2. State transitions are deterministic and recoverable.\n3. Execution paths are sourced from graph data contract.\n4. QA can execute all checklist items without ambiguous behavior.\n",

      "content": "# CodeFly — PRD Part 6: Lifecycle State Machines (Close the Loop)\n**Version:** 1.0 | **Date:** May 2026 | **Purpose:** Enforce complete feature lifecycle ownership and recovery\n\n---\n\n## 0. Why this exists\n\nCodeFly features must be implemented as explicit finite-state machines (FSMs), not ad-hoc event handlers.\n\nFor every feature, this PRD answers:\n1. What state exists?\n2. Who owns it?\n3. How it is created?\n4. How it is read?\n5. How it is destroyed/reset?\n6. What happens on refresh/restart/failure?\n\n---\n\n## 1. Global lifecycle rule (applies to every feature)\n\nEvery feature must implement:\n- `UNINITIALIZED`\n- `READY`\n- `ACTIVE`\n- `ERROR`\n- `RESET`\n\nAnd support these transitions:\n- startup hydration (`UNINITIALIZED -> READY`)\n- user activation (`READY -> ACTIVE`)\n- failure handling (`ACTIVE -> ERROR`)\n- user/system reset (`ERROR|ACTIVE -> RESET -> READY`)\n- page refresh continuity (rehydrate to equivalent state)\n\nNo feature is complete without all transitions.\n\n---\n\n## 2.         "",
        "CodeFly is a browser-based 3D codebase explorer for quickly understanding unfamiliar repositories."
